_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 08 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the rich ThreeWayMatchExceptionPanel Vue view onto the ThreeWayMatchDetail manifest page so the crediteuren-administrateur can run the resolution workflow (accept-with-motivation / file-dispute / reject-and-block-payment) inline on the detail surface. The plain generated detail page lives in slice 01's fragment; this fragment overlays a kind=page custom component that adds the side-by-side PO/GRN/Invoice comparison, the divergence breakdown and the three action buttons. Registered as kind=page custom component in src/registry.js.

pages.title: 3-way Match
pages._note: The page is a side-by-side reconciliation of THREE different objects (purchase order, goods receipt note, supplier invoice) with the per-field divergence computed across them (REQ-PO3W-005). `type: detail` is bound to a single register/schema/:id triple and renders that object's fields; it has no comparison view across three schemas. On top of that the three dispositions (accept with motivation, file dispute, reject and block payment) POST to /api/three-way-match/exceptions/{accept,dispute,reject} sharing one motivation input, which config.lifecycleActions — a per-transition button on the object itself — cannot express.
